methods.label: Convert subtraction to addition
methods.levelReason: Converting subtraction of a negative and evaluating the resulting signed sum are Grade 7 procedures.

candidate.annotationRationale: The task assesses mixed rational-number addition and subtraction. The method converts subtraction to addition and evaluates in order; no regrouping procedure needs a separate annotation. The subtraction and addition rules are local prerequisites. The supplied English translation of the AI-generated explanation is retained; teacher review and human translation review are not recorded.
candidate.changeReason: Subtracting -6 correctly gives +6, and -4+6-3=-1 matches the key. The brief explanation supplies the decisive step.

review.mathematicalCheck: The conversion is valid: \((-4)-(-6)+(-3)=-4+6-3=2-3=-1\). The brief explanation contains the decisive step.
review.levelCheck: Appropriate Grade 7 signed-number arithmetic with sufficient working.
review.methodDistinctness: One complete method is enough for this calculation.
review.annotationCheck: cnm_013 matches mixed addition and subtraction. cnm_012 and cnm_010 support the actual operations; no separate regrouping annotation is needed. Empty shared supportIds is appropriate.
